dedupe_keys.name: scarichi industriali provenienti da insediamenti produttivi puntuale

description: Scarichi industriali provenienti da insediamenti produttivi - puntuale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eds.cittametropolitana.torino.it. Timely location of production plants authorised pursuant to Articles 124/125 of Legislative Decree No 152/2006 which give rise to discharges of industrial waste. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Industrial discharges from production sites - punctual" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT, torino. The listing shows 2024-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
